The white exterior combined with the extensive Weissach Package customization creates a striking visual presence that commands attention on every road.

With 13 distinct drive modes––ranging from full EV to Corsa––every journey can be tuned to electric serenity or unbridled ferocity. VIOLA PASIFAE, EXTERIOR CARBON PACKAGE, FRONT PPF, LOW MILES, AND MORE!

OVERVIEW
The 2025 Lamborghini Revuelto marks a historic chapter for Sant'Agata, ushering in the next era of the raging bull with its first-ever V12 plug-in hybrid high-performance supercar. It's not just a replacement for the Aventador––it's a reimagining of Lamborghini's flagship V12, merging cutting-edge electrification with the rawness that defines the brand's DNA. At its rear sits a brand-new 6.5-liter naturally aspirated V12 paired with three electric motors. The combined system delivers a staggering 1,001 horsepower, making the Revuelto one of the most powerful Lamborghini road cars ever built. The powertrain sends force through an 8-speed dual-clutch transmission, with the rear axle joined by an e-motor while twin motors on the front axle enable torque vectoring all-wheel drive. The result: a launch from 0-62 mph in just 2.5 seconds and a top speed exceeding 217 mph, all while offering the ability to cruise silently in electric-only mode when desired. Visually, the Revuelto's design is an evolution of the fighter jet-inspired aesthetic, with razor-sharp angles, Y-shaped LED signatures, and aggressive aerodynamic sculpting that generates over double the downforce of its predecessor. Lightweight carbon fiber monocoque architecture––including a new carbon front structure––ensures rigidity while reducing mass, thus advancing both safety and performance. Y-themed design cues continue throughout the interior, with Corsa-Tex, fine leather, and carbon fiber accents providing a sporty vibe. With 13 distinct drive modes––ranging from full EV to Corsa––every journey can be tuned to electric serenity or unbridled ferocity. A symbol of where ultra-high-performance motoring is headed, the 2025 Revuelto is destined to become a future collectible in Lamborghini history: a supercar that preserves the soul-stirring sound of a naturally aspirated V12 while embracing the performance-enhancing possibilities of electrification.

OVERVIEW
The 2025 Porsche 911 GT3 RS is the ultimate expression of Porsche's motorsport heritage, distilled into a street-legal supercar. And with the optional Weissach Package, this GT3 RS reaches another level of precision and it pushes the limits of what a naturally aspirated 911 can achieve. At its heart lies a 4.0-liter naturally aspirated flat-six engine, revving to a spine-tingling 9,000 rpm and producing 518 horsepower and 342 lb-ft of torque. Aerodynamics play a starring role, with an aggressive rear diffuser and manually adjustable swan-neck rear wing that generate up to 150% more downforce than its predecessor. Agility is further enhanced by rear-axle steering and Porsche Active Suspension Management. From appearance alone, the GT3's wide body, center-lock wheels, and aggressive aero signal its intent without saying a word. Inside, this track-focused 911 remains modern and functional. Carbon fiber bucket seats, Race-Tex trim throughout, and GT-specific driving modes provide a no-nonsense layout that keeps the focus firmly on driving. As with many Porsches, customization is key. This example features a Dundun exhaust system, ceramic composite brakes, and bespoke Aubergine paint. The 911 GT3 RS is more than just a road car. description:
The 2025 Aston Martin Vanquish V12 stands as a masterpiece of British automotive engineering, delivering an exceptionally refined driving experience crafted for discerning owners who value performance fused with uncompromising elegance.

- 5.2L V12 Turbocharged engine producing 824 horsepower
- ZF 8-Speed Automatic transmission with RWD capability
- Bowers & Wilkins Audio System with 15 speakers
- Heated Sports Plus Seats with leather and Alcantara trim
- Adaptive suspension with four-wheel independent setup
- Navigation System with Apple CarPlay integration
- Ceramic disc brakes with four-wheel independent design
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off functionality
- 21" forged aluminum wheels
- Dual front and side impact airbags with overhead airbags
- Remote keyless entry with security system
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- Speed-sensing steering with power assistance
- Rain-sensing wipers with variably intermittent operation

Finished in pristine white, this V12 presents commanding presence on the road while maintaining the refined aesthetic that defines Aston Martin's design philosophy. The meticulously crafted interior surrounds you with premium materials, including leather and Alcantara seating surfaces, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, and thoughtfully positioned sport controls. Every element has been orchestrated to deliver intuitive operation and sustained comfort across extended drives.

The powertrain demonstrates Aston Martin's commitment to performance excellence. The turbocharged V12 engine delivers responsive power delivery, paired with a sophisticated eight-speed automatic transmission engineered for seamless gear transitions. The adaptive suspension system continuously adjusts to road conditions, ensuring balanced handling while preserving ride quality. Ceramic disc brakes, positioned at all four wheels, provide confident stopping performance.

Technology integration enhances connectivity and convenience without overwhelming the driving experience. Apple CarPlay enables smartphone integration, while the navigation system guides your journeys with precision. The Bowers & Wilkins audio system reproduces music with studio-quality fidelity. Climate control offers dual-zone front programming plus rear window defrosting capability, allowing passengers individual temperature preferences.

Safety systems work discreetly in the background, protecting occupants through multiple airbag strategically placed throughout the cabin, along with electronic stability management and traction control technologies. Speed-sensing steering adjusts responsiveness to match driving conditions, while rain-sensing wipers automatically respond to weather changes.

With just 1,750 miles on the odometer, this vehicle remains virtually new, offering the opportunity to own a freshly delivered luxury performance automobile. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the Vanquish V12 firsthand and understand why this vehicle represents the pinnacle of contemporary grand touring excellence.

Custom leather wrapping covers the upper interior trim, while the carbon fiber and sueded microfiber steering wheel provides both control and premium tactile feedback. Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with multiple power adjustment points and lumbar controls ensure comfort during extended driving sessions. Additional conveniences include wireless device charging, a universal home remote, and automatic high-beam headlights with automatic leveling technology.

Carbon ceramic brakes with dark gray metallic calipers and orange-painted calipers provide stopping power matched to the engine's output. The 20" x 10" front and 21" x 13" rear gloss black forged aluminum wheels complete the aggressive visual package while handling the performance demands this machine presents.

The 2017 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 2LZ represents the pinnacle of American performance engineering, delivering an uncompromising fusion of supercar-slaying power and track-bred precision, finished in a sophisticated Watkins Glen Gray Metallic exterior . This formidable power is channeled through a precise 7-speed manual transmission with Active Rev Matching to the rear wheels, propelling the Z06 from 0-60 mph in just 3.2 seconds and on to a top speed exceeding 195 mph .

The well-appointed 2LZ equipment package outfits the Corvette with aggressive custom wheels, a functional aerodynamic package, and signature LED lighting . Inside, you'll find premium leather seating surfaces with heating and ventilation function, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, and premium Bose® audio. The heads-up display projects critical information directly into your line of sight, eliminating the need to glance downward.

The performance data and video recorder preserves your driving sessions for review. The battery protection package safeguards electrical systems, while electronic stability control and performance traction management systems work behind the scenes to maintain composure during demanding maneuvers.

The removable carbon fiber roof panel balances open-air freedom with the structural benefits of a closed coupe, allowing you to reconfigure the driving experience based on conditions and preference. The adjustable front lift system with memory rises automatically at low speeds to protect the front splitter during curb clearance, then lowers once safe to do so. Combined with the performance exhaust system featuring stainless-steel tips, this Corvette presents a complete package of purposeful design.

This vehicle has been meticulously maintained and offers the opportunity to experience true American sports car performance with modern engineering refinement.

description:
The 2021 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray is a mid-engine two-seat sports car with a low, compact profile and a driver-focused cabin. Its proportions place the passenger compartment far forward relative to the rear-mounted powertrain, and the bodywork follows the compact stance associated with the model line. The exterior surfaces are shaped with a clear emphasis on airflow management and mechanical packaging rather than decorative detail, and the overall appearance reflects the placement of the engine behind the occupants. The cabin sits within a rigid structure that supports the car's performance-oriented design, while the roofline and side glass maintain a tight, enclosed feel. Access is through long doors that open wide enough to make entry and exit manageable for a vehicle of this type.

Inside, the Corvette Stingray uses a two-seat interior trimmed with leather seats. The seating position is low, and the driver faces a cockpit arranged around a compact instrument area and a central control stack that divides the two occupants. Primary controls are grouped within reach, and the surfaces around the seating area present a mix of soft-touch and harder materials typical of a modern sports car. The cabin includes a head up display, which places selected driving information in the forward field of view. Storage is limited, as expected in a car with this shape and purpose, but the interior still provides the basic conveniences needed for daily use, including a center console area and door pockets.

The infotainment system includes navigation and Apple CarPlay. The display is mounted within the center of the dashboard and is integrated with the vehicle's main interface, where audio, communication, and route guidance are controlled. A premium audio system is included, and the cabin also has a Wi-Fi hotspot. These features are arranged in a way that keeps the main controls within the driver's reach while leaving the passenger side relatively uncluttered. The digital elements are paired with physical buttons and switches for core functions, which helps reduce reliance on the screen alone. The system layout is straightforward, with menus and connectivity functions presented through the central display rather than spread across multiple separate interfaces.

The Stingray's driving hardware reflects its role as a performance car, with the engine located behind the seats and power delivered through the rear wheels. The chassis and suspension are tuned for responsive handling, and the car's dimensions contribute to a low center of gravity and a compact footprint. Large wheels, wide tires, and braking hardware are part of the standard presentation of the model, and the visible cooling openings in the bodywork support the mechanical demands of the powertrain. The result is a car built around its mechanical components, with each major system placed to serve that purpose. On the road, the available equipment supports both short trips and longer drives, with the cabin technology and seating materials providing a practical level of comfort alongside the car's core performance capabilities.

Powered by a 3.0-liter twin-turbocharged six-cylinder engine, it delivers an impressive 503 horsepower at 6,250 RPM and 479 lb-ft of torque at 2,750 RPM. With an 8-speed M STEPTRONIC automatic transmission featuring Drivelogic and sport/manual modes, this rear-wheel-drive coupe offers exceptional handling and acceleration. Its mileage of 36,257 miles reflects careful use, and its gasoline engine ensures spirited performance on every drive. This M4 Competition is packed with advanced features designed for safety, comfort, and convenience. Apple CarPlay seamlessly integrates with your smartphone, while a backup camera and blind spot monitor enhance awareness on the road. Bluetooth connectivity, collision warning, cross traffic alert, and a hands-free liftgate make daily driving easier. Inside, you'll find heated leather seats with memory settings, keyless entry, a navigation system, and a premium audio setup with satellite radio. The push start button and wireless charging add modern convenience, making this coupe as functional as it is exhilarating. 2021 BMW M4 Safety and Security Features This M4 is equipped with dual front knee airbags and traffic sign recognition to keep you aware of your surroundings. Premium brakes, front and rear parking sensors, and a regenerative braking system provide control and safety during everyday driving. The vehicle also includes ABS for secure stopping, emergency braking preparation, and cornering brake control to enhance stability. Power door locks feature auto-locking for added security, ensuring peace of mind at all times. 2021 BMW M4 Entertainment and Technology Features Entertainment and connectivity are at the forefront with a 10.25-inch infotainment screen and 14 total speakers delivering immersive sound. BMW ConnectedDrive compatibility allows for smart device app functions, including using your phone as a key. Voice-operated hands-free calling and radio, HD radio, and a 464-watt surround sound system with two subwoofers create a premium audio experience. The system's intuitive interface and high-quality sound make every journey more enjoyable and connected. 2021 BMW M4 Performance Features Performance is the hallmark of this BMW M4 with features like active suspension, electronic suspension control, and driver-adjustable ride control for tailored handling. The auto start/stop system improves efficiency, while a rear locking differential and sport-tuned suspension enhance cornering and stability. The vehicle also features an electronic suspension control system, ensuring optimal ride quality whether you're on the track or city streets.

The 2021 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray 2LT represents the most radical reinvention in the nameplate's history, moving the engine behind the driver for the first time and delivering genuine exotic-car performance at a price that stunned the industry. Reviewers consistently praised its precise handling, surprisingly livable everyday manners, and an interior quality that finally matched the chassis underneath it. Buyers choose this generation of Corvette because it delivers genuine mid-engine dynamics, previously reserved for cars costing multiples more, without asking owners to sacrifice daily usability. It's a car that proves attainable performance and genuine engineering excellence aren't mutually exclusive. This naturally aspirated engine delivers immediate, linear throttle response with none of the lag associated with a turbocharged setup. The 8-speed dual-clutch transmission delivers rapid, precise shifts whether left in automatic mode or worked manually through the paddle shifters. Moving the engine behind the driver gives this Corvette a fundamentally different, more balanced feel through corners than any front-engine Corvette before it, while the Z51 package's performance suspension and electronic limited-slip differential sharpen that dynamic even further. EXTERIOR FEATURES This mid-engine Corvette's exotic proportions and aggressive character lines give it a genuine supercar presence that previous generations could only approach. The installed 19''/20'' staggered wheel setup and Carbon Flash Metallic-painted mirrors and spoiler add further visual distinction, giving this Stingray a genuinely purposeful, track-ready look. INTERIOR FEATURES Inside, the 2LT trim's heated and ventilated GT1 seats create a cabin that's comfortable enough for daily driving despite the car's exotic performance credentials. Memory settings, power lumbar, and bolster adjustment make it easy to dial in a personalized, supportive driving position. Reviewers have consistently noted this generation's cabin quality finally matches the chassis underneath it, with a quiet, well-isolated interior that makes the Corvette a genuinely livable everyday sports car rather than a stripped-down track special. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY The 8-inch touchscreen brings built-in navigation and wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto to this Stingray, while a wireless charging pad keeps compatible phones powered without a cable. The 14-speaker Bose Performance Series audio system delivers genuinely rich, detailed sound. The Performance Data Recorder lets owners capture lap times and video for track days, while the head-up display projects key information directly into the driver's line of sight without looking away from the road. SAFETY FEATURES This 2LT's Rear Camera Mirror and forward-facing HD camera help address the low-slung Corvette's inherent blind spots, giving the driver genuinely useful visibility that earlier generations lacked. Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert adds further confidence in traffic and while changing lanes. There are sports cars… and then there are machines that stir your soul every time you press the start button. The 2016 Alfa Romeo 4C is one of those rare automobiles. Designed and handcrafted in Italy, the 4C delivers a driving experience that few vehicles at any price can match. Lightweight, exotic, and unmistakably Alfa Romeo, this is a true driver’s car that combines breathtaking styling with race-inspired engineering.
If you’ve been searching for a vehicle that turns heads everywhere it goes while delivering an authentic, analog driving experience, you’ve just found it.
Finished in stunning Rosso Competizione Tri-Coat, one of Alfa Romeo’s most desirable premium colors, this beautiful 4C has only 21,423 miles and has been exceptionally maintained. From the moment you see its sculpted body lines, aggressive stance, and unmistakable Italian styling, you’ll understand why enthusiasts around the world consider the Alfa Romeo 4C a modern collectible.
Unlike many sports cars that rely on excessive horsepower, the Alfa Romeo 4C embraces intelligent engineering. Thanks to its incredibly light carbon fiber monocoque chassis, aluminum construction, and race-inspired design, every ounce of weight has been optimized to maximize performance. The result is one of the most engaging driving experiences available today.
Powered by Alfa Romeo’s 1.7-liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine, producing 237 horsepower, paired to a lightning-fast 6-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission, the 4C launches from 0-60 mph in approximately 4.1 seconds while delivering razor-sharp handling that makes every road feel like a race circuit.
Every drive becomes an event.
The turbocharged engine delivers immediate acceleration, while the responsive paddle-shift transmission provides lightning-quick gear changes. Whether you’re carving through winding back roads, enjoying a spirited weekend drive, or simply heading to dinner, the Alfa Romeo 4C offers an unforgettable connection between driver and machine.
One of the defining features of the Alfa Romeo 4C is its Formula One-inspired carbon fiber monocoque chassis. This isn’t just marketing—it’s genuine racing technology. Carbon fiber construction is typically reserved for six-figure supercars from Ferrari, Lamborghini, and McLaren, making the 4C one of the most affordable ways to own a true exotic platform.
The lightweight chassis contributes to remarkable agility, exceptional cornering capability, and outstanding driver feedback. Every input is immediate. Every corner feels alive. Every mile reminds you why driving enthusiasts continue to praise the Alfa Romeo 4C.
Visually, the Rosso Competizione Tri-Coat finish perfectly complements the dramatic Italian design. The sculpted front fascia, flowing body lines, muscular rear fenders, signature circular LED taillights, and center-mounted exhaust create a timeless appearance that continues to attract attention years after its introduction.
Park it anywhere, and expect compliments.
Inside, the cabin embraces simplicity with a purpose. The cockpit is driver-focused, featuring supportive leather sport seats, racing-inspired instrumentation, aluminum pedals, premium materials, and controls positioned exactly where they’re needed. Everything inside the 4C is designed around one objective—delivering the purest driving experience possible.

This 2016 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 3LZ represents a serious driver's machine, built for those who demand performance and precision on every road.

- Visible Carbon Fiber Ground Effects Package with aggressive splitter and rockers
- Z07 Performance Package with carbon ceramic brakes and level 3 Aero Package
- Z07 Suspension with Magnetic Selective Ride Control
- Michelin Pilot Super Sport Cup 2 summer-only run flat tires (P285/30ZR19 front, P335/25ZR20 rear)
- 8-Speed Automatic with paddle shift and automatic modes
- 4-wheel antilock, 4-wheel disc ceramic braking system
- Head-Up Display for critical performance data at a glance
- Chevrolet MyLink Navigation with Apple CarPlay integration
- Bose Premium Audio System with 9 speakers and SiriusXM compatibility
- Heated and vented leather front bucket seats with power adjusters and memory settings
- Sueded microfiber-wrapped interior trim package
- Performance Data and Video Recorder to capture your driving sessions
- Front and rear parking cameras with front curb view
- Custom leather-wrapped interior package
- 19" x 10" front and 20" x 12" rear Z06 Pearl wheels

This Z06 features the legendary V8 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission offering both automatic and manual paddle shift control. The combination delivers 13 mpg in the city and 23 mpg on the highway. The Z07 Performance Package elevates this machine further with its carbon ceramic braking system, track-focused suspension tuning, and aggressive aerodynamics designed for serious performance driving.

The interior reflects meticulous attention to detail with genuine leather, sueded microfiber trim accents, and a sport steering wheel wrapped in leather. The heated and vented front seats provide comfort for extended drives, while the power adjusters and memory function allow you to find your ideal driving position instantly. Every control is positioned for driver engagement, from the leather-wrapped shift knob to the tachometer and performance-focused instrumentation.

Technology integration enhances both comfort and capability. The Head-Up Display keeps essential information visible without distracting from the road. Chevrolet MyLink with navigation provides intuitive control, while Apple CarPlay connectivity keeps you linked to your devices. The Bose audio system delivers refined sound for your drive, complemented by SiriusXM radio access and premium 9-speaker configuration.

Safety and control technology works quietly in the background. The four-wheel independent suspension, electronic stability control, and traction control provide confidence in varied driving conditions. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and dual front and side airbags protect you during daily driving. Low tire pressure warning and the emergency communication system add layers of security.

This Corvette Z06 stands ready for someone who appreciates engineering excellence and purposeful design. With 61,611 miles, it represents a vehicle that has been maintained and can deliver years of dependable performance. Schedule a time to view this machine in person and experience the quality that defines this generation of American performance.

This 2015 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray 1LT represents an opportunity to own a sports car that delivers genuine performance and distinctive styling. With 41,520 miles, this white Corvette is ready to provide years of driving satisfaction for the discerning enthusiast.

- 6.2L V8 engine with 8-speed paddle shift transmission and automatic modes
- Carbon Flash painted Z51-style spoiler
- Leather seating surfaces with GT bucket seats
- Bose premium 9-speaker audio system with SiriusXM
- Chevrolet MyLink infotainment system
- Heated power door mirrors with power adjustment
- Remote vehicle starter system
- Rear parking camera
- High-intensity discharge headlights with delay-off feature
- Automatic temperature control with front dual-zone air conditioning
- Limited-slip rear axle ratio
- Leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- OnStar Directions & Connections emergency communication

The powertrain combines responsive handling with real-world capability. The 6.2L V8 delivers highway efficiency at 29 mpg while city driving achieves 16 mpg. The 8-speed automatic with paddle shift puts control in your hands, allowing you to engage the driving experience actively or let the transmission manage gear selection seamlessly. The 2.41 limited-slip rear axle ratio enhances traction and cornering stability.

Inside, the Corvette surrounds you with purposeful design. Mulan perforated leather seating surfaces in the GT bucket seats provide comfort and visual appeal. The sport steering wheel with tilt and telescoping adjustment accommodates all drivers. Premium amenities include a leather shift knob, illuminated entry, and front reading lights. The Bose audio system with nine speakers reproduces your favorite content with clarity, while SiriusXM brings satellite radio to your commute.

Safety and visibility benefit from comprehensive engineering. Four-wheel independent suspension provides confident handling characteristics. Dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, and occupant sensing technology form a protective system. High-intensity discharge headlights with automatic operation ensure visibility in changing conditions. The rear parking camera adds practical assistance when maneuvering.

The exterior presents the distinctive Corvette character through genuine styling. The carbon flash painted Z51-style spoiler is a Chevrolet accessory that adds purposeful visual presence. Body-color bumpers and heated power mirrors complete the refined appearance. The removable carbon fiber roof panel allows personalization to suit your preference. Eighteen-inch front and nineteen-inch rear five-spoke alloy wheels provide a contemporary stance.

This Corvette carries a clean Carfax report with no accidents noted, providing confidence in its condition and history. Whether you seek weekend driving enjoyment or a capable daily driver, this 2015 Corvette Stingray 1LT offers genuine sports car capability. We invite you to schedule a time to experience this vehicle in person and begin the next chapter of your automotive ownership.

This 2015 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray 2LT represents a significant opportunity to own one of America's most iconic performance vehicles in stunning Crystal Red Tintcoat.

- 1-Piece Removable Transparent Roof Panel
- 6.2L V8 Engine with 8-Speed Paddle Shift Automatic
- Bose Advanced 10-Speaker Audio System
- Head-Up Display
- Memory Package
- Heated & Vented Driver & Passenger Seats
- Power Lumbar/Bolster Seat Adjusters
- Auto-Dimming Inside Frameless Rearview Mirror
- Body-Color Outside Heated Power-Adjustable Mirrors
- GT Bucket Seats with Perforated Leather
- Universal Home Remote
- Remote Vehicle Starter System
- Chevrolet MyLink Audio System with SiriusXM
- Exterior Parking Camera with Rear View
- High-Intensity Discharge Headlights

The iconic Corvette Stingray design delivers the performance and presence you expect from this legendary nameplate. The removable transparent roof panel transforms your driving experience, allowing you to connect with the road in ways few vehicles can match. Whether you choose to cruise with the roof in place or remove it for open-air driving, this two-seater adapts to your preference.

Inside, the Stingray surrounds you with premium comfort and control. The GT bucket seats feature perforated leather and offer power lumbar and bolster adjustments to keep you comfortable during extended drives. The heated and vented seat functions provide year-round comfort, while the auto-dimming rearview mirror and head-up display enhance both convenience and safety. The 2LT interior trim reflects the vehicle's premium positioning, and the memory package ensures your seat and mirror preferences are retained each time you drive.

The 6.2L V8 engine delivers the power characteristic of the Corvette lineage, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission featuring paddle shift controls. This combination provides both ease of daily driving and the ability to take direct control when you desire it. Achieving 16 mpg in the city and 29 mpg on the highway, the engine balances performance with reasonable fuel economy for a vehicle of this caliber.

Technology integrates seamlessly into the Stingray experience through the Chevrolet MyLink audio system, which includes SiriusXM satellite radio and a Bose advanced 10-speaker audio system to deliver quality sound for your favorite content. Bluetooth connectivity and the remote vehicle starter system add practical benefits to your daily driving routine. The universal home remote provides additional convenience, and the exterior parking camera assists with maneuvering and parking awareness.

Safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, and a comprehensive airbag system designed to protect occupants. OnStar Directions & Connections offers additional peace of mind with emergency communication capabilities and turn-by-turn navigation guidance.

This Corvette Stingray 2LT combines the performance heritage, refined interior appointments, and practical technology that define this vehicle's appeal to discerning drivers who appreciate both capability and craftsmanship.

This 2015 Ford Mustang GT Premium delivers authentic American performance in a striking black exterior. With just under 20,000 miles, this low-mileage machine represents an exceptional opportunity to own a modern muscle car that has been carefully maintained. The GT Performance Package transforms the driving experience with precision engineering, including a sophisticated suspension setup with strut-tower brace and K-brace reinforcement, paired with HD front springs and an upsized rear sway bar for responsive handling.

The heart of this Mustang is its 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT engine, paired with a 6-Speed Manual transmission and rear-wheel drive for a connected, engaging driving experience. The 3.73 TORSEN Limited-Slip Rear Axle Ratio ensures optimal traction and performance delivery. Stopping power comes from Brembo 6-piston front brake calipers and larger brake rotors, providing the confidence and control you expect from a premium performance vehicle.

Inside, the Premier Trim features a charcoal black interior with color-accented seats and unique door trim that reinforces the GT's purposeful character. The Engine Turn Aluminum Finish Instrument Panel adds visual interest while the Gauge Pack displays oil pressure and vacuum readings for those who appreciate mechanical feedback. The Shaker Pro Audio System with 12 speakers delivers quality sound, while the Memory Driver Seat and Mirrors store up to three settings for personalized comfort.

Your entertainment options include a Chevrolet MyLink Audio System with six speakers, SiriusXM satellite radio, and integrated Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility through USB ports. Safety features encompass dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags, complemented by a comprehensive security system and emergency communication.

This Camaro SS 1SS with the 1LE Track Performance Package represents a carefully engineered platform for drivers who understand the value of purposeful performance. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand.

The ParkView rear camera provides clear visibility when reversing, while Electronic Stability Control and advanced airbag systems protect you and your passengers. Remote keyless entry, HomeLink garage door control, and the emergency communication system through SiriusXM Guardian round out a comprehensive suite of protective features.

This 2018 Challenger SRT 392 represents authentic muscle car capability paired with modern amenities. With 37,247 miles and a complete feature set designed for performance and daily satisfaction, it stands ready for the next chapter of ownership. We invite you to experience this vehicle firsthand and discover why the SRT 392 remains a compelling choice for those who appreciate genuine automotive character.

The NissanConnect navigation system provides turn-by-turn guidance, and emergency communication services offer peace of mind during longer journeys.

2007 Ford Mustang GT Supercharged For Sale

This 2007 Ford Mustang GT is a well-sorted supercharged S197 build finished in white with blue stripes, showing approximately 35,000 miles. The build work was performed in 2007 by Alternative Auto Performance Inc. of Chesterfield Township, Michigan, meaning this car was modified early in its life by a single shop rather than accumulating a piecemeal collection of parts over multiple owners. It shows in the coherence of the combination, which pairs serious forced-induction output with supporting drivetrain hardware, a full round of exterior styling upgrades, and an upgraded audio system. The white-over-blue livery is a nod to one of the most recognizable color combinations in Mustang history, and it suits the car's intent well.

Power comes from a Whipple supercharged 4.6L V8 that has been dyno tested at 504 horsepower. Supporting the blower are a 3250cfm billet big bore elliptical throttle body, Ford Performance hot rod camshafts, BBK 1 5/8-inch ceramic-coated long tube headers, and a Hurst axle-back exhaust, with an S&B True Flow air filter and JLT pre-filter handling intake duties. It is a combination that addresses airflow on both the intake and exhaust sides rather than simply bolting boost onto an otherwise stock engine. Gear changes go through a 5-speed manual transmission fitted with a McLeod Street Extreme clutch kit and a Hurst billet short throw shifter, and the rear end runs 3.73 gears for strong acceleration and responsive feel in the lower gears.

Chassis work is focused where it matters most on this platform, with front and rear sway bars from Roush to sharpen turn-in and reduce body roll. The exterior carries MMD quarter window louvers, a chin spoiler, hood scoop, and rear valence diffuser, along with MGP red caliper covers. Lighting has been updated throughout with Raxiom smoked sequential taillights and a flashing third brake light, plus LED conversions for the headlights, fog lights, and map lights. Under the hood, the presentation is finished with a Ford-insignia oil cap and strut tower covers along with a color-matched SpeedForm radiator cover extension. Inside, a modern billet push-button ignition replaces the factory key setup, and the factory Shaker 500 system has been built out with an Alpine amplifier and audio controller, an enclosed 10-inch subwoofer, and a touchscreen Bluetooth head unit with Android Auto and Apple CarPlay.

For a buyer looking for a modified S197 with real supercharged power, a manual transmission, low mileage, and a shop-built combination that was carried through the driveline, chassis, exterior, and interior rather than stopping at the engine, this one covers a lot of ground.

This 2016 Dodge Challenger R/T Scat Pack arrives in striking Redline Red Tricoat Pearl, commanding attention wherever it goes with its bold presence and purposeful design.

- SRT HEMI 6.4L V8 engine with 8-Speed Automatic transmission
- Quick Order Package 24Y 392 Hemi Scat Pack Shaker
- 20" forged and painted aluminum wheels
- MOPAR Shaker Hood with underhood Shaker decal and mounted 392 HEMI badge
- Shaker Package with Scat Pack graphics and stripe
- Heated and ventilated leather performance seats with Nappa leather accents
- Leather performance steering wheel, heated for comfort
- High-Intensity Discharge headlamps with fog lights
- Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection with rear backup camera
- Remote Start System and Universal Garage Door Opener
- 506-Watt amplifier with 9 amplified speakers and subwoofer
- Rear Black Spoiler and black grille with Bezel
- Uconnect 8.4" touchscreen with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Performance steering and power tilt/telescope steering column
- Push-button start with keyless entry

The Scat Pack badge on this Challenger represents a commitment to serious performance. The SRT HEMI 6.4L V8 delivers the kind of driving engagement that enthusiasts seek, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission that handles acceleration and highway cruising with equal competence. Real-world performance translates to 14 mpg in the city and 23 mpg on the highway, giving you a sense of what to expect at the pump.

The interior reflects the premium nature of this vehicle. Heated and ventilated leather-trimmed seats keep you comfortable in any season, while the heated steering wheel adds a practical luxury touch on cold mornings. The leather performance steering wheel puts you in command, and performance steering ensures responsive handling. The Uconnect 8.4" touchscreen integrates SiriusXM satellite radio, USB connectivity, and AUX input for your media needs.

Visibility and safety matter on any drive. The high-intensity discharge headlamps cut through darkness effectively, complemented by automatic headlights and front fog lights. Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection technology provides additional awareness at highway speeds and in tight quarters. The rear backup camera gives you confidence when reversing. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work quietly in the background to maintain grip.

The Shaker Package elevates the visual presence throughout. MOPAR Shaker components, including the iconic hood, fender badges, and graphics, speak to the enthusiast DNA of this machine. The distinctive Scat Pack stripe runs across the hood and body, supported by a rear black spoiler that's functional as well as aesthetic. At 20 inches, the forged aluminum wheels fill the wheel wells properly and contribute to the aggressive stance.

Driver Convenience features round out the package. Remote Start lets you warm the engine before climbing in. Universal Garage Door Opener keeps your driveway accessible. Power multi-function foldaway mirrors adjust to your preference, and the power tilt/telescope steering column ensures you find your ideal driving position.

This Challenger R/T Scat Pack is ready to deliver the driving experience you've been looking for. We invite you to schedule a time to see it in person and take it out for a drive.

Convenience
  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
Safety and Security
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Head-up display - Keep your head up! You don't have to take your eyes off of the road to get information from your dashboard anymore. With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. Because when you're driving, the most important information lies on the road ahead. Keep your eyes on the road with head-up display.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

This 2016 Ford Mustang GT Premium delivers authentic performance and style in a timeless American icon built for drivers who appreciate genuine driving dynamics.

- 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT engine with 6-speed manual transmission
- GT Performance Package with Brembo 6-piston front brake calipers
- 3.73 TORSEN Limited-Slip Rear Axle Ratio
- 19" Ebony Black painted aluminum wheels (19" x 9" front, 19" x 9.5" rear)
- Summer-only performance tires (255/40R19 front, 275/40R19 rear)
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Collision Mitigation
- Blind Spot Information System with Cross-Traffic Alert
- Shaker Pro Audio System with 12 speakers and HD Radio
- Rain-Sensing Windshield Wipers
- Memory Driver Seat with Power Adjustment
- Engine Turn Aluminum Instrument Panel with Gauge Pack
- Larger Radiator and Larger Brake Rotors
- Exterior Parking Camera with Rear View
- High-Intensity Discharge Headlights with Delay-Off Feature

The GT Performance Package transforms this Mustang into a focused machine for the track and road. Unique chassis tuning, strut-tower bracing, and K-brace structural reinforcement work together to sharpen handling response. The electronic power-assisted steering has been recalibrated for GT-specific feedback, while unique stability control settings allow experienced drivers to dial in their preferred balance between control and engagement.

Enhanced stopping power comes from the Brembo 6-piston front brake system paired with larger brake rotors throughout. HD front springs and upgraded suspension geometry complement the structural improvements, creating a platform that communicates road conditions directly to the driver. The 3.73 TORSEN limited-slip rear axle keeps power distributed effectively through corners and during acceleration.

The interior balances sport and sophistication. The engine-turned aluminum instrument panel sets an upscale tone, while the gauges display oil pressure and vacuum readings for drivers who want detailed engine information. Power front bucket seats with memory function on the driver side ensure your preferred driving position is always ready. Steering wheel audio controls and a modern infotainment system keep essential functions within reach.

Safety and convenience features include adaptive cruise control with collision mitigation, blind spot monitoring with cross-traffic alert, and rain-sensing wipers that adjust automatically to weather conditions. The rearview camera provides additional visibility when backing, while high-intensity discharge headlights offer superior nighttime illumination.

With 33,239 miles, this Mustang GT Premium remains fresh and ready for its next chapter. The combination of genuine performance engineering, documented maintenance capability, and timeless design makes this an opportunity to own a modern classic that continues to satisfy the drivers who appreciate what a real Mustang offers.

This 2023 Toyota GR86 Premium delivers a driving experience that combines precision engineering with genuine performance capability, backed by a well-maintained single-owner history.

- Aftermarket modified suspension for enhanced handling dynamics
- Aftermarket modified exhaust system
- Close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission
- 2.4L I4 DOHC engine with RWD configuration
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Backup camera with rear parking assistance
- Bluetooth connectivity
- Heated front sport bucket seats with Alcantara leather trim
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- Perrin intake system for optimized air flow
- Heated door mirrors
- 7.5" x 18" twin 10-spoke matte black alloy wheels
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- SiriusXM satellite radio with HD audio
- Electronic stability control and traction control

The engineering foundation of this GR86 Premium speaks for itself. The 2.4L inline-four engine pairs with a close-ratio six-speed manual transmission, delivering responsive power delivery and an engaging connection between driver and machine. At 20 city and 27 highway MPG, this powertrain balances performance with reasonable fuel efficiency. The rear-wheel-drive layout combined with the aftermarket suspension and exhaust modifications creates a vehicle that handles with intent and purpose.

Inside, the cabin emphasizes driver engagement without sacrificing comfort. Heated sport bucket seats wrapped in Alcantara leather provide support during spirited driving, while heated front seats ensure comfort during colder months. The leather-trimmed steering wheel and shift knob enhance the tactile experience, and the telescoping, tilt-adjustable steering wheel accommodates drivers of varying heights. Automatic temperature control maintains cabin comfort, while the eight-speaker audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio keeps you entertained throughout your journey.

Technology integration keeps you connected seamlessly. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility allow you to access your phone's features through the vehicle's interface, while Bluetooth connectivity extends this wireless capability. The backup camera provides additional visibility when reversing, and the remote keyless entry system adds convenience to daily operation.

Safety systems protect you and your passengers comprehensively. A full complement of airbags, including front dual impact, front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags, work in concert with electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension to maintain control in demanding situations. ABS brakes with brake assist provide confident stopping power, and the low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed about your vehicle's maintenance needs.

The matte black alloy wheels and body-color bumpers complement the gray exterior, while the integrated spoiler adds visual presence. Power windows, mirrors, and steering, combined with fully automatic headlights and delay-off functionality, handle everyday conveniences efficiently.

This one-owner GR86 Premium represents a well-maintained sports coupe ready for your ownership. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the combination of precision handling, manual transmission engagement, and modern conveniences this vehicle offers.

This 2023 Dodge Challenger GT delivers the classic American muscle car experience with modern refinement and practicality. With its striking gray exterior and proven 3.6L V6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive capability, this Challenger offers the performance character you expect from this iconic nameplate combined with year-round traction confidence.

- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with service
- Uconnect 4 with 7" touchscreen display
- Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto integration
- ParkView rear backup camera
- Front dual-zone automatic temperature control with rear window defroster
- Power driver seat with adjustable lumbar support
- Heated exterior mirrors with power adjustment
- Sport steering wheel with audio controls
- 20" satin carbon alloy wheels
- Houndstooth cloth performance bucket seats
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- Dual front airbags with anti-whiplash front head restraints
- Bluetooth connectivity with voice command
- Media hub with two USB ports and auxiliary input

The interior strikes a balance between performance-focused design and everyday comfort. Power windows, locks, and mirrors combine with cruise control and a telescoping tilt steering wheel to make longer drives manageable. The Uconnect 4 infotainment system with its 7-inch display integrates Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto, keeping your smartphone's features within easy reach. Heated exterior mirrors and front dual-zone climate control address weather concerns, while the rear seat center armrest and split-folding rear seatback provide flexibility for passengers and cargo.

Safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, and a comprehensive airbag system with dual front and front side impact protection. The ParkView rear backup camera assists with maneuvering in tight spaces, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power. Low tire pressure monitoring ensures you're alerted to any air concerns before they become problems.

With an EPA rating of 18 city and 27 highway mpg, this Challenger balances performance expectations with reasonable fuel economy. The all-wheel drive system provides year-round driving confidence, while the 3.6L engine delivers the power and responsiveness Dodge Challenger drivers appreciate. At 70,853 miles, this vehicle has been well-maintained and represents a genuine opportunity to own a modern Challenger with depreciation already factored in.

The Gray Granite Pearlcoat exterior finish enhances the Challenger's muscular stance and turns heads whether parked or in motion. Body-color bumpers and mirrors, along with the integrated spoiler, reinforce the performance aesthetic that defines this model.

This 2023 BRZ Limited combines spirited performance, responsive handling, and genuine daily usability. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this vehicle firsthand. Our team stands ready to answer your questions and help you evaluate whether this sports car aligns with your driving preferences and lifestyle.

Experience the thrill of driving with this 2012 INFINITI G37 Coupe, a stylish and powerful vehicle that combines luxury with performance. Featuring a sleek Graphite Shadow exterior paired with a sophisticated Stone interior, this coupe is designed to turn heads. Under the hood, you'll find a robust 3.7-liter V6 engine producing 330 horsepower at 7000 RPM and 270 lb-ft of torque at 5200 RPM, all powered by a naturally aspirated setup. With a weight of just 0.4759 and a rear-wheel-drive layout, this coupe offers dynamic handling and a spirited ride. Its sporty two-door body style comfortably seats four, making it perfect for those who value style and practicality. Despite being a used vehicle, it maintains an excellent condition with 98,726 miles, promising reliability and fun on every drive. This G37 Coupe is packed with features that enhance convenience and visibility. Fog lights and xenon headlights improve nighttime and adverse weather visibility, while keyless entry and push-start ignition provide seamless access and operation. Satellite radio readiness ensures access to a wide range of entertainment options, keeping you connected on the go. Its elegant exterior in Gray complements the refined interior, offering a balanced mix of style and function. Whether cruising city streets or highway roads, this coupe combines sporty performance with premium features to satisfy driving enthusiasts. 2012 INFINITI G37 Coupe Safety and Security Features This coupe prioritizes safety with active head restraints at the front to reduce injury in a collision. It includes four-wheel anti-lock braking system (ABS) for superior stopping power and stability. Power door locks with anti-lockout feature prevent accidental lock-ins, while auto-locking locks add an extra layer of security when the vehicle is in motion, giving peace of mind for drivers and passengers alike. 2012 INFINITI G37 Coupe Entertainment and Technology Features Entertainment comes through a 6-disc in-dash CD changer complemented by a 7-inch infotainment screen for easy access to controls and navigation. The sound system features six speakers, delivering clear and balanced audio for all passengers. For additional connectivity, the G37 Coupe offers auxiliary audio/video input, allowing you to connect external devices and enjoy your favorite media on the go.

This 2012 BMW 1 Series 128i delivers refined driving dynamics and premium comfort in a compact luxury package that remains relevant today.

- Heated front seats
- Boston leather upholstery
- Premium Package with power front seats and lumbar support
- 2-way power glass moonroof
- Auto-dimming and power-folding exterior mirrors with memory

- Front fog lights

- Universal garage-door opener

The 3.0-liter inline six-cylinder engine pairs with a smooth 6-speed automatic Steptronic transmission, delivering responsive performance whether navigating city streets or cruising highways. The rear-wheel drive configuration provides the balanced handling BMW is known for, while the independent four-wheel suspension absorbs road imperfections with composure.

Inside, the cabin reflects thoughtful design with multiple layers of convenience and comfort. Premium leather seating wraps occupants in quality, while the heated seats and steering wheel provide welcome warmth during colder months. Power adjustments with driver memory settings allow personalized positioning, and the integrated Bluetooth connectivity keeps you connected without distraction.

The premium package elevates the ownership experience with refined details—illuminated door handles welcome you each time you approach, while the dual-zone climate control ensures driver and passenger comfort preferences are independently managed. The panoramic moonroof opens up the cabin to natural light and fresh air, creating an airy atmosphere that defines modern luxury compact cars.

Safety receives equal attention here, with dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, and BMW's anti-whiplash front head restraints working in concert. Electronic stability control and traction control manage wheel grip and vehicle dynamics, while brake assist technology enhances stopping confidence in emergency situations.

This 128i represents nearly a decade of BMW ownership potential. Visit our showroom to experience the quality construction and engaging driving character that have made this model a respected choice among luxury compact car buyers.

This 2012 Nissan Altima 3.5 SR delivers reliability and comfort for the driver who values both performance and practicality.

- 3.5L V6 DOHC 24V engine with CVT transmission
- Bose premium audio system with XM satellite radio
- RearView monitor for convenient backup visibility
- Dual zone automatic temperature control
- Power moonroof
- 18" alloy wheels
- Leather-appointed seats with multi-adjustable front buckets
- Bluetooth® hands-free phone system
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- Front fog lights with fully automatic headlights
- Speed-sensitive steering and wipers
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- 4.3" color display
- USB and iPod inputs

The heart of this sedan is a capable 3.5L V6 engine paired with a CVT transmission, offering a balance of efficiency and responsive driving dynamics. With an EPA rating of 20 city and 27 highway miles per gallon, this Altima provides reasonable fuel economy for everyday commuting and longer trips alike.

Inside, you'll find a well-appointed cabin designed with your comfort in mind. The leather-appointed seats feature multi-adjustable front buckets that allow you to find your ideal driving position, while the split-folding rear seats provide flexibility for cargo needs. Dual zone automatic temperature control ensures both driver and passenger can set their preferred comfort levels independently.

Entertainment and connectivity are central to your driving experience. The Bose premium audio system delivers quality sound through nine speakers, complemented by XM satellite radio, CD playback, and modern connectivity options including Bluetooth® hands-free calling, USB input, and iPod integration. The 4.3" color display and steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road while managing features easily.

Safety and handling have been carefully engineered throughout this vehicle. A comprehensive airbag system, four-wheel disc ABS brakes, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to give you confidence in various driving conditions. The four-wheel independent suspension combined with speed-sensitive steering provides composed handling while the front fog lights and fully automatic headlights enhance visibility.

Practical features round out the package nicely. The RearView monitor assists when reversing, the power moonroof adds an open-air dimension to your driving, and the 18" alloy wheels provide both style and durability. Heated door mirrors, speed-sensitive wipers, and the trip computer with outside temperature display keep you informed and comfortable in all seasons.

This Altima represents a solid mid-size sedan option ready for the driver seeking dependable transportation with modern comforts and proven engineering.
